controls.name: information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: All information security roles and responsibilities should be defined and communicated to ensure that all personnel understand their responsibilities regarding information security.

deployment_points.name: Define specific information security roles within the organization, including responsibilities for data protection, incident response, and compliance.
Create a comprehensive document outlining these roles and responsibilities, ensuring clarity and accessibility for all personnel.
Communicate the defined roles through training sessions, workshops, and internal communications to ensure understanding.
Regularly review and update the roles and responsibilities to reflect changes in the organization or regulatory requirements.
Implement a feedback mechanism to gather input from personnel on the clarity and effectiveness of the defined roles.

controls.name: segregation of duties
controls.description: Responsibilities and duties should be segregated to reduce the risk of accidental or deliberate misuse of resources.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical processes within the organization that require segregation of duties to mitigate risks.
Define and document the specific roles involved in each critical process, ensuring that no single individual has control over all aspects.
Implement access controls and permissions in systems to enforce the segregation of duties.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with the segregation of duties policy and identify any potential violations.
Provide training to employees on the importance of segregation of duties and the risks associated with its violation.

controls.name: contact with authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities should be established to ensure that the organization can respond effectively to incidents and comply with legal requirements.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant authorities, such as law enforcement, regulatory bodies, and industry-specific organizations, that the organization should maintain contact with.
Establish formal communication channels with these authorities, including contact lists and escalation procedures.
Train key personnel on how to engage with authorities during incidents and ensure they understand the legal implications of information security.
Regularly review and update contact information and communication protocols to ensure they remain current.
Conduct tabletop exercises to simulate interactions with authorities during incident response scenarios.

controls.name: contact with special interest groups
controls.description: The organization should maintain contact with special interest groups to stay informed about information security threats and best practices.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant special interest groups, such as industry associations, cybersecurity forums, and information sharing organizations.
Establish membership or participation in these groups to gain access to resources, threat intelligence, and best practices.
Designate personnel responsible for engaging with these groups and sharing insights with the broader organization.
Regularly attend meetings, webinars, and conferences hosted by these groups to stay informed about emerging threats and trends.
Create a knowledge-sharing platform within the organization to disseminate information gathered from these groups.

controls.name: information security in project management
controls.description: Information security should be integrated into project management processes to ensure that security considerations are addressed throughout the project lifecycle.

deployment_points.name: Develop a project management framework that includes information security as a key component in all phases of the project lifecycle.
Train project managers and team members on the importance of integrating security considerations into project planning, execution, and closure.
Conduct risk assessments for projects to identify potential security vulnerabilities and develop mitigation strategies.
Establish security checkpoints at various stages of the project to ensure compliance with security requirements.
Document lessons learned from projects to improve future integration of information security in project management.

controls.name: security in supplier relationships
controls.description: The organization should ensure that security requirements are established and communicated to suppliers to protect the organization's information assets.

deployment_points.name: Define security requirements that suppliers must meet to protect the organization's information assets, including data handling and access controls.
Include these security requirements in contracts and agreements with suppliers to ensure legal enforceability.
Conduct due diligence on suppliers to assess their security posture and compliance with established requirements.
Establish a monitoring process to regularly review supplier compliance with security requirements and address any deficiencies.
Provide training and resources to suppliers to help them understand and meet the organization's security expectations.

controls.name: information security in the supply chain
controls.description: The organization should manage information security risks associated with the supply chain to ensure the protection of information assets.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment of the supply chain to identify potential information security risks associated with suppliers and third parties.
Develop a supply chain security policy that outlines security expectations and requirements for all parties involved.
Implement monitoring and auditing processes to ensure compliance with the supply chain security policy.
Establish incident response protocols for supply chain-related security incidents to ensure timely and effective responses.
Foster collaboration with suppliers to share best practices and improve overall supply chain security.

controls.name: information security awareness, education, and training
controls.description: The organization should ensure that all personnel receive appropriate information security awareness, education, and training to understand their responsibilities and the importance of information security.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive information security awareness and training program tailored to the organization's needs and risks.
Schedule regular training sessions and workshops to ensure all personnel receive up-to-date information on security policies and practices.
Utilize various training methods, such as e-learning, in-person sessions, and simulations, to engage employees effectively.
Measure the effectiveness of training through assessments and feedback to continuously improve the program.
Create a culture of security awareness by encouraging employees to report security incidents and share security tips.

controls.name: disciplinary process
controls.description: The organization should establish a disciplinary process for personnel who fail to comply with information security policies and procedures.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear disciplinary policy that outlines the consequences of non-compliance with information security policies.
Communicate the disciplinary policy to all personnel to ensure understanding and awareness of potential repercussions.
Establish a process for investigating incidents of non-compliance, including documentation and reporting procedures.
Train managers and supervisors on how to enforce the disciplinary process fairly and consistently.
Regularly review and update the disciplinary policy to ensure it remains effective and aligned with organizational goals.

controls.name: compliance with legal and contractual requirements
controls.description: The organization should ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements related to information security.

deployment_points.name: Identify all applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements related to information security that the organization must comply with.
Develop a compliance framework that outlines how the organization will meet these requirements, including policies and procedures.
Assign responsibility for compliance oversight to a designated individual or team within the organization.
Conduct regular audits and assessments to evaluate compliance with legal and contractual requirements and address any gaps.
Provide training to personnel on relevant legal and regulatory requirements to ensure awareness and understanding.

controls.name: screening
controls.description: The organization shall screen individuals prior to employment, or prior to assignment to sensitive positions, to reduce the risk of theft, fraud, or misuse of assets.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive screening policy that outlines the criteria for screening candidates, including background checks, reference checks, and verification of qualifications.
Implement a standardized process for conducting screenings, ensuring that all candidates undergo the same level of scrutiny based on their role and sensitivity of the position.
Utilize third-party services for background checks to ensure objectivity and thoroughness, while complying with legal and regulatory requirements.
Train HR personnel on the screening process and the importance of maintaining confidentiality and data protection during the screening.
Regularly review and update the screening process to adapt to changing risks and ensure it remains effective.

controls.name: terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that employees and contractors understand their responsibilities and are subject to disciplinary processes in the event of a breach of security.

deployment_points.name: Draft clear and comprehensive terms and conditions of employment that explicitly outline security responsibilities and expectations.
Ensure that all employees and contractors receive a copy of these terms during onboarding and that they acknowledge understanding through a signed document.
Develop a communication plan to regularly remind employees of their responsibilities regarding security and the consequences of breaches.
Establish a formal disciplinary process that is fair, transparent, and consistently applied to all employees and contractors.
Train managers on how to enforce these terms and handle breaches appropriately, ensuring they understand the importance of security compliance.

controls.name: awareness, education, and training
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that all employees and contractors receive appropriate awareness training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

deployment_points.name: Develop a training program that includes initial onboarding training and ongoing education sessions tailored to different job functions and security needs.
Schedule regular training sessions and updates to ensure that all employees and contractors are kept informed of the latest security policies and procedures.
Utilize various training methods, such as e-learning, workshops, and simulations, to engage employees and enhance retention of information.
Implement a tracking system to monitor attendance and completion of training programs, ensuring accountability.
Gather feedback from participants to continuously improve the training content and delivery methods.

controls.name: disciplinary process
controls.description: The organization shall implement a formal disciplinary process to ensure that employees and contractors are aware of the consequences of breaching security policies and procedures.

deployment_points.name: Create a documented disciplinary policy that outlines the steps involved in the disciplinary process, including investigation, hearings, and appeals.
Ensure that all employees and contractors are informed of this policy during onboarding and through regular communications.
Train managers and HR personnel on how to apply the disciplinary process fairly and consistently, emphasizing the importance of documentation.
Establish a review board or committee to oversee disciplinary actions and ensure they are handled appropriately.
Regularly review and update the disciplinary process to ensure it remains effective and aligned with organizational goals.

controls.name: responsibilities for information security
controls.description: The organization shall define and communicate the information security responsibilities of all employees and contractors.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear framework that defines specific information security responsibilities for different roles within the organization.
Communicate these responsibilities through job descriptions, employee handbooks, and training sessions to ensure understanding.
Implement a system for tracking and reporting on compliance with these responsibilities, including regular audits and assessments.
Encourage a culture of accountability by recognizing and rewarding employees who demonstrate strong adherence to their security responsibilities.
Regularly review and update the defined responsibilities to reflect changes in roles, technology, and security threats.

controls.name: contact with authorities
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities to ensure that it can respond effectively to security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant authorities, such as law enforcement, regulatory bodies, and cybersecurity organizations, that the organization should maintain contact with.
Establish formal communication channels with these authorities, including designated points of contact and protocols for reporting incidents.
Conduct regular meetings or briefings with authorities to stay informed about current security threats and best practices.
Develop an incident response plan that includes procedures for engaging with authorities during a security incident.
Review and update contact information and protocols regularly to ensure they remain current and effective.

controls.name: contact with special interest groups
controls.description: The organization shall maintain contact with special interest groups to ensure that it is aware of current security threats and vulnerabilities.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant special interest groups, such as industry associations, security forums, and threat intelligence networks, that provide valuable insights into security threats.
Establish membership or participation in these groups to gain access to resources, training, and networking opportunities.
Designate a team or individual responsible for monitoring communications from these groups and disseminating relevant information within the organization.
Schedule regular updates or briefings to share insights gained from these groups with key stakeholders in the organization.
Evaluate the effectiveness of the engagement with these groups periodically to ensure they continue to meet the organization's security needs.

controls.name: information security in project management
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that information security is addressed in project management, including the allocation of resources and responsibilities.

deployment_points.name: Integrate information security considerations into the project management framework, ensuring that security is a key component of project planning and execution.
Assign specific security roles and responsibilities within project teams to ensure accountability for security outcomes.
Conduct risk assessments for projects to identify potential security vulnerabilities and develop mitigation strategies.
Provide training for project managers on information security best practices and the importance of incorporating security into project lifecycles.
Establish a review process to evaluate the security aspects of projects at key milestones and upon project completion.

controls.name: physical security perimeter
controls.description: Establish a physical security perimeter to protect the facility from unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a site assessment to identify the boundaries of the facility and potential vulnerabilities.
Install physical barriers such as fences, walls, or gates to delineate the perimeter.
Implement surveillance systems, including cameras and motion detectors, to monitor the perimeter continuously.
Establish access control points with security personnel or automated systems to manage entry and exit.
Regularly review and update perimeter security measures based on threat assessments and incidents.

controls.name: physical entry controls
controls.description: Implement physical entry controls to ensure only authorized personnel can access the facility.

deployment_points.name: Identify and classify personnel based on access needs and roles within the organization.
Install access control systems such as key cards, biometric scanners, or PIN codes at entry points.
Train staff on the importance of access control and the procedures for granting access.
Regularly audit access logs to ensure compliance and identify any unauthorized access attempts.
Implement a visitor management system to track and control guest access to the facility.

controls.name: securing offices, rooms, and facilities
controls.description: Ensure that offices, rooms, and facilities are secured against unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify sensitive areas that require additional security measures.
Install locks, access control systems, and security alarms on doors to sensitive areas.
Develop and enforce policies for securing offices and rooms when not in use, including locking doors and securing windows.
Train employees on the importance of securing their workspaces and reporting any security concerns.
Regularly inspect and maintain security measures to ensure they are functioning properly.

controls.name: protecting against external and environmental threats
controls.description: Implement measures to protect the facility against external and environmental threats.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a threat assessment to identify potential external and environmental risks, such as natural disasters or vandalism.
Install protective measures such as flood barriers, fire suppression systems, and reinforced windows.
Develop an emergency response plan that includes procedures for various external threats.
Train staff on emergency procedures and conduct regular drills to ensure preparedness.
Regularly review and update protective measures based on changing environmental conditions and threat levels.

controls.name: working in secure areas
controls.description: Establish procedures for working in secure areas to maintain security and confidentiality.

deployment_points.name: Define secure areas within the facility and establish access restrictions for these locations.
Develop and document procedures for entering and working in secure areas, including sign-in/out protocols.
Train employees on the importance of maintaining confidentiality and security in these areas.
Implement monitoring systems to track access and activities within secure areas.
Regularly review and update procedures to address any security incidents or changes in operations.

controls.name: public access, delivery, and loading areas
controls.description: Control public access, delivery, and loading areas to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive areas.

deployment_points.name: Designate specific areas for public access, deliveries, and loading to minimize exposure to sensitive areas.
Install barriers and signage to clearly mark restricted areas and guide public traffic.
Implement a check-in process for delivery personnel, including verification of credentials and purpose.
Train staff on monitoring and controlling access in these areas to prevent unauthorized entry.
Regularly assess and update access controls based on operational needs and security assessments.

controls.name: equipment security
controls.description: Ensure that equipment is secured against theft, damage, or unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Conduct an inventory of all equipment and classify it based on value and sensitivity.
Implement physical security measures such as locks, cages, or secure storage areas for high-value equipment.
Train employees on the importance of securing equipment and reporting any suspicious activity.
Regularly audit equipment security measures and update them as necessary.
Develop a policy for the use and transportation of equipment to minimize risks.

controls.name: secure disposal or reuse of equipment
controls.description: Implement procedures for the secure disposal or reuse of equipment to prevent data leakage.

deployment_points.name: Develop a policy outlining the procedures for the secure disposal or reuse of equipment, including data sanitization methods.
Train staff on the importance of secure disposal and the risks associated with improper handling of equipment.
Partner with certified e-waste disposal companies to ensure compliance with regulations.
Maintain records of disposed or reused equipment, including serial numbers and methods of data destruction.
Regularly review and update disposal procedures to align with best practices and regulatory requirements.

controls.name: clear desk and clear screen policy
controls.description: Establish a clear desk and clear screen policy to protect sensitive information.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear desk and clear screen policy that outlines expectations for employees regarding sensitive information.
Communicate the policy to all staff and provide training on its importance.
Implement regular audits to ensure compliance with the policy and address any violations.
Provide secure storage options for sensitive documents and encourage their use.
Regularly review and update the policy to address new risks and changes in the work environment.

controls.name: physical security of assets
controls.description: Ensure that physical security measures are in place to protect assets from theft or damage.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive asset inventory to identify all physical assets that require protection.
Implement security measures such as surveillance cameras, alarms, and security personnel to monitor asset locations.
Develop and enforce policies for asset handling and storage to minimize risks.
Train employees on the importance of asset security and reporting any security incidents.
Regularly review and update security measures based on asset value and potential threats.

controls.name: monitoring physical access
controls.description: Implement monitoring measures to track physical access to the facility.

deployment_points.name: Install access control systems such as keycard readers or biometric scanners at all entry points to the facility.
Set up a centralized logging system to record all access attempts, including successful and failed entries.
Regularly review access logs to identify any unauthorized access attempts or patterns of concern.
Integrate surveillance cameras in key areas to monitor physical access and ensure footage is stored securely for a defined retention period.
Conduct periodic audits of the access control system to ensure it is functioning correctly and that all access points are monitored.

controls.name: visitor control
controls.description: Establish procedures for controlling visitors to ensure they are authorized and monitored.

deployment_points.name: Develop a visitor management policy that outlines the process for visitor registration, identification verification, and access permissions.
Implement a visitor check-in system that requires visitors to present valid identification and sign in upon arrival.
Assign staff members to escort visitors during their stay to ensure they remain in authorized areas.
Provide visitors with identification badges that must be worn at all times while on the premises.
Conduct regular training for employees on visitor control procedures to ensure compliance and awareness.

controls.name: physical security training
controls.description: Provide training on physical security measures to all personnel.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive training program that covers physical security policies, procedures, and best practices.
Schedule regular training sessions for all employees, including new hires, to ensure everyone is informed about physical security measures.
Utilize various training methods such as workshops, e-learning modules, and hands-on drills to enhance understanding and retention.
Assess employee understanding through quizzes or practical exercises to ensure they can apply what they have learned.
Keep training materials updated and relevant to address emerging threats and changes in security protocols.

controls.name: review of physical security controls
controls.description: Regularly review and update physical security controls to ensure their effectiveness.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular reviews of all physical security controls, ideally on a quarterly or bi-annual basis.
Form a review committee that includes security personnel, facility management, and IT representatives to assess the effectiveness of current controls.
Collect feedback from employees regarding the physical security measures in place and any observed vulnerabilities.
Document findings from each review and create an action plan for addressing any identified weaknesses or areas for improvement.
Ensure that updates to physical security controls are communicated to all personnel and that training is provided on any new measures implemented.

controls.name: access control
controls.description: Ensure that access to technological resources is restricted to authorized users only.

deployment_points.name: Implement role-based access control (RBAC) to define user roles and permissions.
Conduct a thorough user access review to identify and remove unnecessary access rights.
Utilize multi-factor authentication (MFA) to enhance security for accessing sensitive resources.
Regularly update access control policies to reflect changes in user roles or organizational structure.
Monitor and log access attempts to detect unauthorized access and respond accordingly.

controls.name: data encryption
controls.description: Implement encryption mechanisms to protect sensitive data both at rest and in transit.

deployment_points.name: Identify sensitive data that requires encryption and classify it accordingly.
Choose appropriate encryption algorithms and tools for data at rest and in transit.
Implement encryption for databases, file systems, and communication channels (e.g., SSL/TLS).
Regularly review and update encryption keys and manage their lifecycle securely.
Train staff on the importance of encryption and how to handle encrypted data.

controls.name: network security
controls.description: Establish measures to protect the network infrastructure from unauthorized access and attacks.

deployment_points.name: Deploy firewalls and intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS) to monitor and control network traffic.
Segment the network to limit access to sensitive areas and reduce attack surfaces.
Regularly conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing to identify weaknesses.
Implement secure configurations for network devices and regularly update them.
Establish a network monitoring system to detect and respond to suspicious activities.

controls.name: malware protection
controls.description: Deploy anti-malware solutions to detect and prevent malicious software from compromising systems.

deployment_points.name: Select and install reputable anti-malware software on all endpoints and servers.
Configure the software for automatic updates to ensure the latest threat definitions are used.
Schedule regular scans of systems to detect and remove malware.
Educate users on recognizing phishing attempts and suspicious downloads.
Maintain an incident response plan specifically for malware infections.

controls.name: backup and recovery
controls.description: Ensure regular backups of critical data and establish recovery procedures to restore data in case of loss.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical data and systems that require regular backups.
Implement an automated backup solution that performs regular backups according to a defined schedule.
Store backups in a secure, offsite location to protect against physical disasters.
Regularly test the recovery process to ensure data can be restored quickly and accurately.
Document backup and recovery procedures and train staff on their execution.

controls.name: patch management
controls.description: Implement a process for timely application of security patches and updates to software and systems.

deployment_points.name: Establish a patch management policy that defines roles, responsibilities, and timelines for patching.
Regularly monitor vendor announcements for security updates and patches.
Test patches in a controlled environment before deploying them to production systems.
Automate the patch deployment process where possible to ensure timely application.
Maintain an inventory of all software and systems to track patch status and compliance.

controls.name: incident response
controls.description: Establish an incident response plan to address and manage security incidents effectively.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive incident response plan that outlines roles, responsibilities, and procedures.
Conduct regular training and simulations for the incident response team to ensure preparedness.
Establish communication protocols for reporting and escalating incidents.
Implement tools for incident detection, logging, and analysis to facilitate response efforts.
Review and update the incident response plan regularly based on lessons learned from past incidents.

controls.name: user training
controls.description: Provide training to users on security best practices and awareness to mitigate risks.

deployment_points.name: Develop a security awareness training program tailored to the organization's needs.
Schedule regular training sessions and refreshers to keep users informed of current threats.
Utilize various training methods, such as e-learning, workshops, and phishing simulations.
Measure the effectiveness of training through assessments and feedback.
Encourage a culture of security by promoting open communication about security concerns.

controls.name: physical security
controls.description: Implement physical security measures to protect technological assets from unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify physical security vulnerabilities in the organization.
Install access control systems (e.g., key cards, biometric scanners) to restrict entry to sensitive areas.
Implement surveillance systems (e.g., cameras) to monitor critical locations.
Train staff on physical security protocols and the importance of securing physical assets.
Regularly review and update physical security measures based on evolving threats.

controls.name: remote access security
controls.description: Establish security measures for remote access to ensure secure connections to organizational resources.

deployment_points.name: Implement a Virtual Private Network (VPN) to secure remote connections to the organization.
Require multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all remote access attempts.
Regularly review and update remote access policies to reflect current security practices.
Monitor remote access logs for unusual activity and respond to potential threats.
Educate users on secure remote access practices and the risks associated with remote work.

controls.name: configuration management
controls.description: Maintain secure configurations for all technological assets to reduce vulnerabilities.

deployment_points.name: Establish a baseline configuration for all technological assets, including servers, workstations, and network devices, to ensure consistency and security.
Implement automated tools to monitor and enforce compliance with the established configurations, ensuring any deviations are flagged for review.
Regularly review and update configuration standards to address new vulnerabilities and changes in technology.
Train IT staff on secure configuration practices and the importance of maintaining these configurations.
Document all configuration changes and maintain an audit trail to facilitate accountability and traceability.

controls.name: third-party security
controls.description: Assess and manage security risks associated with third-party vendors and partners.

deployment_points.name: Develop a third-party risk assessment framework that includes criteria for evaluating the security posture of vendors.
Conduct regular security assessments of third-party vendors, including reviewing their security policies and practices.
Establish contractual obligations for third-party vendors to adhere to your organization's security standards.
Monitor third-party compliance through regular audits and assessments, ensuring they maintain the required security measures.
Create a communication plan to address security incidents involving third parties, ensuring timely notification and response.

controls.name: data loss prevention
controls.description: Implement measures to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration and loss.

deployment_points.name: Identify and classify sensitive data within the organization to understand what needs protection.
Deploy data loss prevention (DLP) solutions that monitor and control data transfers, both in and out of the organization.
Establish policies for data handling, including encryption, access controls, and secure data disposal methods.
Train employees on data protection best practices and the importance of safeguarding sensitive information.
Regularly review and update DLP policies and technologies to adapt to new threats and changes in data usage.

controls.name: logging and monitoring
controls.description: Establish logging and monitoring mechanisms to detect and respond to security events.

deployment_points.name: Implement centralized logging solutions to collect and store logs from all critical systems and applications.
Define log retention policies to ensure logs are kept for an appropriate duration for compliance and investigation purposes.
Set up real-time monitoring and alerting mechanisms to detect suspicious activities and potential security incidents.
Regularly review logs for anomalies and conduct investigations on any detected incidents.
Train security personnel on log analysis techniques and the importance of timely incident response.

controls.name: secure software development
controls.description: Adopt secure coding practices and conduct security testing throughout the software development lifecycle.

deployment_points.name: Integrate security into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) by adopting secure coding standards and guidelines.
Conduct regular security training for developers to ensure they are aware of common vulnerabilities and secure coding practices.
Implement automated security testing tools to identify vulnerabilities during the development process.
Perform manual code reviews and security assessments before deploying software to production.
Establish a feedback loop to continuously improve security practices based on lessons learned from past vulnerabilities.

controls.name: mobile device management
controls.description: Implement policies and technologies to manage and secure mobile devices accessing organizational data.

deployment_points.name: Develop a mobile device management (MDM) policy that outlines acceptable use, security requirements, and employee responsibilities.
Deploy MDM solutions to enforce security policies, such as encryption, remote wipe, and access controls on mobile devices.
Train employees on the importance of mobile security and best practices for protecting organizational data on their devices.
Regularly review and update MDM policies and technologies to address new threats and changes in mobile device usage.
Monitor mobile device compliance with security policies and take corrective actions for non-compliance.

controls.name: cloud security
controls.description: Establish security measures for data and applications hosted in cloud environments.

deployment_points.name: Assess the security features and compliance certifications of cloud service providers before engaging their services.
Implement encryption for data at rest and in transit to protect sensitive information stored in the cloud.
Establish access controls and identity management solutions to restrict access to cloud resources based on the principle of least privilege.
Regularly review cloud configurations and security settings to ensure they align with organizational security policies.
Monitor cloud usage and security events to detect and respond to potential threats in real-time.

controls.name: identity and access management
controls.description: Implement identity and access management solutions to control user access to systems and data.

deployment_points.name: Deploy an identity and access management (IAM) solution to centralize user authentication and authorization processes.
Define user roles and access levels based on job responsibilities to enforce the principle of least privilege.
Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to enhance security for user access to critical systems.
Regularly review user access rights and remove access for users who no longer require it.
Train employees on secure access practices and the importance of safeguarding their credentials.

controls.name: secure configuration for network devices
controls.description: Ensure network devices are securely configured to minimize vulnerabilities.

deployment_points.name: Develop secure configuration guidelines for all network devices, including routers, switches, and firewalls.
Implement automated tools to assess and enforce compliance with secure configurations on network devices.
Regularly review and update configuration standards to address emerging threats and vulnerabilities.
Train network administrators on secure configuration practices and the importance of maintaining device security.
Document all configuration changes and maintain an audit trail for accountability and compliance purposes.

controls.name: vulnerability management
controls.description: Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and remediation activities to address security weaknesses.

deployment_points.name: Establish a vulnerability management program that includes regular scanning and assessment of systems and applications.
Prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk and potential impact to the organization, focusing on critical vulnerabilities first.
Implement a remediation plan that outlines steps to address identified vulnerabilities, including patch management and configuration changes.
Conduct regular training for IT staff on vulnerability management best practices and tools.
Review and update the vulnerability management program regularly to adapt to new threats and changes in the IT environment.

controls.name: security policy enforcement
controls.description: Enforce security policies and procedures across all technological controls and systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop comprehensive security policies that cover all technological aspects of the organization.
Communicate these policies to all employees and stakeholders to ensure understanding and compliance.
Implement technical controls that automatically enforce these policies, such as firewalls and intrusion detection systems.
Regularly review and update the policies to adapt to new threats and changes in technology.
Conduct training sessions to ensure that all employees are aware of the policies and their responsibilities.

controls.name: data classification
controls.description: Classify data based on sensitivity and apply appropriate security controls accordingly.

deployment_points.name: Establish a data classification framework that defines categories based on sensitivity levels (e.g., public, internal, confidential).
Train employees on how to classify data correctly and the importance of data sensitivity.
Implement automated tools to assist in the classification process, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
Regularly audit classified data to ensure compliance with classification policies.
Review and update classification criteria periodically to reflect changes in data sensitivity.

controls.name: secure disposal of data
controls.description: Implement procedures for the secure disposal of data and technological assets.

deployment_points.name: Develop a secure data disposal policy that outlines methods for data destruction (e.g., shredding, wiping).
Train employees on the importance of secure disposal and the procedures to follow.
Implement a tracking system to log disposed data and assets to ensure accountability.
Regularly review disposal methods to ensure they meet current security standards.
Conduct audits to verify compliance with disposal procedures and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: information security audits
controls.description: Conduct regular audits to assess compliance with information security policies and controls.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular information security audits, including frequency and scope.
Define the criteria and metrics for assessing compliance with security policies.
Assign qualified personnel or third-party auditors to conduct the audits.
Document findings and recommendations from audits and communicate them to relevant stakeholders.
Implement corrective actions based on audit findings and track progress to ensure compliance.

controls.name: business continuity planning
controls.description: Develop and maintain business continuity plans to ensure operations can continue during disruptions.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a business impact analysis to identify critical functions and resources.
Develop a comprehensive business continuity plan that outlines procedures for maintaining operations during disruptions.
Train employees on their roles and responsibilities within the business continuity plan.
Regularly test and update the plan to ensure its effectiveness and relevance.
Establish communication protocols to inform stakeholders during a disruption.

controls.name: security awareness programs
controls.description: Implement ongoing security awareness programs to educate employees about security risks and practices.

deployment_points.name: Develop a security awareness training program that covers key topics such as phishing, password security, and data protection.
Schedule regular training sessions and refreshers to keep security awareness top of mind.
Utilize various training methods, including e-learning, workshops, and simulations, to engage employees.
Measure the effectiveness of the training through assessments and feedback.
Update training content regularly to address emerging threats and changes in security practices.

controls.name: data integrity controls
controls.description: Establish controls to ensure the integrity of data throughout its lifecycle.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical data and establish integrity requirements for each data type.
Implement technical controls such as checksums, hashes, and validation rules to monitor data integrity.
Regularly review and update data integrity controls to adapt to new threats and changes in data usage.
Conduct periodic audits to assess the effectiveness of data integrity measures.
Train employees on the importance of data integrity and their role in maintaining it.

controls.name: access control lists
controls.description: Utilize access control lists to manage permissions for users and groups effectively.

controls.name: policies for information security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals and if significant changes occur.

deployment_points.name: Define the information security policy by gathering input from stakeholders and aligning it with organizational goals.
Obtain management approval for the policy through formal meetings and documentation.
Publish the policy on the organization's intranet and ensure it is accessible to all employees.
Communicate the policy through training sessions and awareness programs, ensuring all personnel acknowledge their understanding.
Schedule regular reviews of the policy, at least annually, and after significant changes in the organization or its environment.

controls.name: information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization needs.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify key information security roles needed within the organization.
Define specific roles and responsibilities, ensuring clarity in job descriptions and expectations.
Allocate roles to personnel based on their skills and organizational needs, ensuring no overlap in conflicting responsibilities.
Communicate these roles and responsibilities to all relevant personnel through training and documentation.
Regularly review and update roles as the organization evolves or as new threats emerge.

controls.name: segregation of duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical processes within the organization that require segregation of duties to mitigate risks.
Map out existing roles and responsibilities to identify potential conflicts.
Redesign processes to ensure that no single individual has control over conflicting duties, implementing checks and balances.
Document the segregation of duties policy and communicate it to all employees involved in critical processes.
Monitor compliance with the segregation of duties policy through regular audits and reviews.

controls.name: management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop a management commitment statement emphasizing the importance of information security.
Integrate information security responsibilities into performance evaluations for all personnel.
Provide training for management on their role in enforcing information security policies.
Establish a reporting mechanism for security incidents and ensure management is involved in the response process.
Regularly review management's adherence to information security responsibilities and adjust policies as necessary.

controls.name: contact with authorities
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant authorities, such as law enforcement and regulatory bodies, that pertain to the organization's industry.
Establish formal communication channels with these authorities, including contact lists and protocols for engagement.
Schedule regular meetings or updates with authorities to stay informed about changes in regulations and security threats.
Document all interactions with authorities and maintain records for compliance purposes.
Train personnel on the importance of these contacts and how to engage with authorities in case of incidents.

controls.name: contact with special interest groups
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.

deployment_points.name: Research and identify relevant special interest groups and professional associations in the field of information security.
Join these groups and participate in their activities, such as forums, webinars, and conferences.
Designate personnel to represent the organization in these groups and ensure they share insights with the broader team.
Document key takeaways from group interactions and disseminate this information within the organization.
Regularly evaluate the benefits of these contacts and adjust participation as necessary.

controls.name: threat intelligence
controls.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

deployment_points.name: Establish a threat intelligence program that outlines the types of threats to monitor and the sources of information.
Utilize automated tools to collect threat data from various sources, including open-source intelligence and commercial feeds.
Analyze the collected data to identify trends and potential threats relevant to the organization.
Share threat intelligence findings with relevant stakeholders and integrate them into security policies and procedures.
Regularly review and update the threat intelligence program to adapt to the evolving threat landscape.

controls.name: information security in project management

deployment_points.name: Develop a framework for integrating information security into the project management lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, and closure.
Train project managers on the importance of information security and how to incorporate it into their projects.
Conduct risk assessments for projects to identify potential security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.
Document security requirements for each project and ensure they are included in project plans.
Review completed projects for compliance with information security requirements and gather lessons learned for future projects.

controls.name: inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.

deployment_points.name: Identify all information and associated assets within the organization, including hardware, software, and data.

Implement regular audits to ensure the accuracy and completeness of the inventory.

controls.name: acceptable use of information and other associated assets

deployment_points.name: Develop an acceptable use policy that outlines the rules for using organizational information and assets.

Implement procedures for monitoring compliance with the acceptable use policy, including regular audits.
Establish a reporting mechanism for violations of the policy and ensure appropriate disciplinary actions are taken.
Review and update the acceptable use policy regularly to reflect changes in technology and organizational needs.

controls.name: return of assets
controls.description: Personnel and other interested parties as appropriate shall return all the organizationΓÇÖs assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear policy outlining the process for returning assets upon termination or change of employment.

Implement a checklist for employees to follow when returning assets, ensuring all items are accounted for.
Designate a responsible party or team to oversee the asset return process and verify the return of all items.
Maintain a log of returned assets for auditing purposes and to track compliance with the policy.

controls.name: classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.

deployment_points.name: Establish a classification framework that defines categories of information based on sensitivity and security needs.
Train employees on the classification framework and the importance of proper classification.
Implement tools or software to assist in the classification of information and ensure compliance.
Regularly review and update the classification framework to adapt to changing business needs and regulatory requirements.
Conduct audits to ensure that information is classified correctly and that employees are adhering to the classification policies.

controls.name: labelling of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Create a labelling policy that aligns with the information classification scheme, detailing how information should be labelled.
Develop templates and tools for consistent labelling across all types of information.
Train staff on the labelling procedures and the significance of accurate labelling for security.
Implement a monitoring system to ensure compliance with labelling procedures.
Review and update labelling procedures regularly to ensure they remain effective and relevant.

controls.name: information transfer
controls.description: Information transfer rules, procedures, or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities within the organization and between the organization and other parties.

deployment_points.name: Develop comprehensive information transfer policies that outline acceptable methods and protocols for transferring information.
Ensure that all employees are trained on the information transfer policies and the importance of secure transfer methods.
Implement secure transfer tools and technologies to facilitate safe information exchange.
Establish agreements with external parties that define the security requirements for information transfer.
Regularly review and audit information transfer processes to identify and mitigate any risks.

controls.name: access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Define access control policies that specify who can access what information and under what circumstances.

Train employees on access control policies and the importance of safeguarding sensitive information.
Regularly review access rights and adjust them as necessary to reflect changes in roles or responsibilities.
Monitor access logs to detect any unauthorized access attempts and respond accordingly.

controls.name: identity management
controls.description: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.

deployment_points.name: Implement an identity management system that tracks the entire lifecycle of user identities from creation to deletion.

Train staff on the identity management processes and the importance of maintaining accurate identity records.
Regularly audit identity management practices to ensure compliance with policies and identify any discrepancies.
Integrate identity management with access control systems to streamline user access based on their identity status.

controls.name: authentication information
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process, including advising personnel on appropriate handling of authentication information.

deployment_points.name: Develop a policy for the allocation and management of authentication information, including passwords and tokens.

Implement a secure process for issuing and revoking authentication information to ensure only authorized personnel have access.

controls.name: access rights

deployment_points.name: Establish a clear policy for provisioning, reviewing, modifying, and removing access rights based on job roles.

controls.name: information security in supplier relationships

controls.name: addressing information security within supplier agreements

deployment_points.name: Define information security requirements that must be included in all supplier agreements.

Monitor supplier compliance with the agreed-upon information security requirements.

controls.name: managing information security in the information and communication technology (ict) supply chain

deployment_points.name: Identify and assess the information security risks associated with each ICT supplier by conducting a thorough risk assessment.

Implement a supplier onboarding process that includes security requirements and assessments to ensure compliance with the organization's security standards.
Regularly review and update the risk management processes to adapt to changes in the supply chain or emerging threats.
Train relevant staff on the defined processes and procedures to ensure consistent application across the organization.

controls.name: monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.

controls.name: information security for use of cloud services

controls.name: information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.

controls.name: assessment and decision on information security events

controls.name: learning from information security incidents

controls.name: collection of evidence

controls.name: information security during disruption

controls.name: ict readiness for business continuity

Implement training sessions for employees to ensure awareness and understanding of these legal obligations.

controls.name: intellectual property rights

controls.name: protection of records

Implement access controls to restrict unauthorized access to sensitive records.

Train personnel on the importance of record protection and the specific measures in place.

controls.name: privacy and protection of personal identifiable information (pii)

Implement technical and organizational measures to safeguard PII, including encryption and access controls.

controls.name: independent review of information security

controls.name: compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security

Provide training and awareness programs to ensure all employees understand their responsibilities regarding compliance.

controls.name: documented operating procedures

controls.name: screening

Maintain confidentiality and compliance with applicable laws during the screening process.

Provide training to employees on their responsibilities regarding information security as outlined in their contracts.

controls.name: information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

controls.name: disciplinary process

controls.name: information security event reporting

deployment_points.name: Create a clear and accessible reporting procedure for employees to follow when they observe or suspect security events.

controls.name: physical security parameters

Regularly assess the effectiveness of monitoring systems and make improvements as necessary.

controls.name: protecting against physical and environmental threats
